reviews.author: Marcus T.
reviews.text: Summit replaced our roof two days after a hail storm. They handled the insurance paperwork completely and the roof looks fantastic. Zero pressure, zero surprises.

reviews.author: Linda R.
reviews.text: Quick, professional, and clean. The crew took before/after photos and left the yard spotless. Best contractor experience we've had in 20 years.

reviews.author: David K.
reviews.text: They found a small leak and repaired it the same day I called. Fair price and they even showed me the photos of what was wrong.

testimonials.author: Rebecca Alvarez
testimonials.quote: From the first inspection to the final walkthrough, Summit was professional and transparent. They explained every line item and came in under budget. Our new roof survived the spring storms without a single issue.

testimonials.author: Tom & Sandra Ellis
testimonials.quote: After a tornado went through our neighborhood, Summit was at the door within hours. They filed the claim, dealt with the adjuster, and had our roof done in four days. We couldn't have asked for more.

testimonials.author: Priya Nair
testimonials.quote: We manage 12 rental properties and Summit handles every roof on our portfolio. Their maintenance program has cut our emergency repair costs dramatically.
